limitations_and_boundaries: The study does not include in vivo validation of the tri-culture findings.
The differentiation protocol was optimized for H1 hESCs and may require adaptation for other hPSC lines.
Sample sizes were not predetermined by statistical methods.
Data collection and analysis were not blinded, but automated methods were used to reduce bias.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: How can microglia be derived from hPSCs via primitive hematopoiesis, and can a tri-culture system of microglia, astrocytes, and neurons be used to model neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease?

provenance.text_excerpt: microglia are the main source of C1Q in our system and that APPSWE+/+ tri-cultures have increased C1Q secretion and accumulation as compared to WT tri-cultures

claims.statement: Microglia are the main source of C1Q in the tri-culture system, and APPSWE+/+ tri-cultures have increased C1Q secretion and accumulation compared to WT tri-cultures.

provenance.text_excerpt: this increase is due to astrocytic C3 induced by microglia, as well as due to microglial C3 re-induced by astrocytes

claims.statement: Increased C3 in APPSWE+/+ tri-cultures is due to astrocytic C3 induced by microglia and microglial C3 re-induced by astrocytes.

experiments_or_tasks: Assemble tri-cultures of hPSC-derived microglia, astrocytes, and neurons (WT or APPSWE+/+).
Measure C3 and C1Q levels by ELISA.
Use C3 KO hPSCs to determine cellular source of C3.

methods.name: Tri-culture assembly and C3/C1Q measurement
methods.protocol_description: Neurons were plated at 200,000 cells per cm2, astrocytes at 25,000 cells per cm2 after 4 days, microglia at 50,000 cells per cm2 after additional 4 days. Medium was changed every other day with IL-34 and M-CSF. After 7 days, LPS (1 μg ml−1) was added for 72 h. Supernatants were analyzed by Millipore Luminex Multiplex Kit for C3 and C1Q.

methods.name: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout of C3 in hPSCs
methods.protocol_description: PX458 vector with guide 5′ TCTGCACTATCCAGGTA 3′ was nucleofected into H1 hESCs. GFP-sorted single-cell clones were screened for indels by Sanger sequencing. Clones with indels were expanded and differentiated into microglia; lack of C3 secretion was validated by ELISA.

claims.statement: WNT inhibition must occur within 18-24 hours after WNT activation to efficiently generate KDR+CD235A+ hemangioblasts.

provenance.text_excerpt: The KDR+CD235A+ hemangioblast population produced CD41+CD235A+CD43+ hematopoietic cells within 3 d after isolation... In contrast, the KDR+CD235A− population failed to produce hematopoietic cells.

claims.statement: KDR+CD235A+ hemangioblasts give rise to hematopoietic cells, while KDR+CD235A- definitive precursors do not under these conditions.

experiments_or_tasks: Optimize timing of WNT inhibition to a narrow window of 18-24 hours after WNT activation.

Pattern hPSCs towards primitive streak mesoderm by activating WNT signaling with CHIR99021, then inhibit WNT with IWP2 and activate Nodal signaling with activin A to generate KDR+CD235A+ hemangioblasts.
Replate KDR+CD235A+ cells in hematopoietic cytokines to generate CD45+ macrophage precursors by day 10.

methods.name: hPSC differentiation to microglial precursors
methods.protocol_description: hPSCs were patterned with CHIR99021 (3 μM) for 18 h, then treated with IWP2 (2 μM), activin A (7.5-10 ng ml−1), BMP4 (30-40 ng ml−1), and FGF2 (20 ng ml−1) for ~2 d + 6 h. Cells were replated at day 3 in medium containing VEGF, FGF2, SCF, IL-6, TPO, IL-3. At day 10, CD45+ cells were harvested.
